C1041.title: Bank Employee Illegally Queried and Sold Credit Information
C1041.summary: In March 2023, the Supreme People's Procuratorate described enforcement against crimes involving infringement of citizens' personal information and said industry insiders leaking personal information remained a serious issue across sectors such as finance, real estate, vehicle administration, healthcare, communications, and property management. One example involved defendant Sun illegally querying citizens' credit information through his bank credit inquiry role and selling it to others for profit.

references.title: Procuratorates Punish Crimes Involving Infringement of Citizens' Personal Information and Promote Personal Information Protection
